jobs.title: Audio-Visual (AV) & IT Engineer (m/w/d) UBS Digital Art Museum, Hamburg
jobs.description:
Mit dem UBS Digital Art Museum entsteht derzeit in der Hamburger HafenCity Europas größtes Museum für digitale und immersive Kunst. Auf mehreren tausend Quadratmetern entsteht ein Ort, an dem Kunst und Technologie auf besondere Weise zusammenspielen.

Für unser Technik-Team suchen wir einen AV & IT Engineer (m/w/d), mit mindestens 4 Jahren praktischer Erfahrung, der die integrierten Technologieumgebungen verwaltet, nach Protokoll betreibt sowie per Remote-Support mit unserem japanischen Partner wartet und kalibriert.

In dieser Rolle schlägst Du die Brücke zwischen klassischer AVL-Technik und moderner IT-Infrastruktur. Du betreust plattformübergreifende Betriebssysteme wie Windows und macOS, AV-Netzwerkswitches und fortschrittliche Display- sowie interaktive Technologien, einschließlich High-End-Projektoren von Epson und LiDAR-Sensoren.

Du hast Freude daran, komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und sorgst für eine nahtlose Konnektivität. Für die Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen und internationalen Teams bringst Du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.

Aufgaben

1. AVL- & Interaktive Systemtechnik

Technischer Betrieb und Überwachung der AVL Anlagen der neu gebauten Museums

Projektorkalibrierung: Wartung von professionellen Projektoren inklusive Edge-Blending, Projection Mapping und Geometriekorrektur

Sensortechnologie: Support und Fehlerbehebung von Sensorik für interaktive Installationen, Tracking-Systeme oder räumliche Anwendungen

Movinglight-Systeme: Support und Fehlerbehebung einer komplexen, interaktiven Movinglight-Festinstallation

Signalfluss-Optimierung: Fehleranalyse und Sicherstellung der Kommunikation zwischen Sensoren, Medienservern und Display-Hardware

2. Netzwerk- & IT-Infrastruktur

Switch-Verwaltung: Administration und Fehlerbehebung von AV-Netzwerkswitches, die für Protokolle mit hoher Bandbreite optimiert sind (z. B. Dante, AVB, NDI,)

IT-Support: Bereitstellung von robustem Tier-1/2/3-Support in heterogenen Systemlandschaften (Windows, macOS und Q-SYS Steuerung).

3. Kommunikation & Dokumentation

Schnittstellenfunktion

Effektive Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch mit internen Stakeholdern, Dienstleistern und japanischen Partnern. Mit täglichem Reporting

Pflege von Systemarchitekturen, IP-Schemata, Netzwerk Topologien und Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs) in Englisch oder Deutsch

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 4 Jahre im Bereich AV-Engineering, IT-Systemintegration oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld

Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (Professional Working Proficiency) für technische Diskussionen und Dokumentationen

Betriebssysteme: Tiefgehende Administrations- und Troubleshooting-Kenntnisse unter Windows und mac-OS

Netzwerktechnik: Solides Verständnis von TCP/IP-Netzwerken, insbesondere in der Konfiguration von Switches (z. B. Netgear AV Line) für AV over IP

Hardware-Kenntnisse: Direkte Erfahrung in der Handhabung, Mo

jobs.title: Senior Meta Designer - Unannouced Project
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At NaturalMotion, we make games that wow people. We innovate to create previously impossible experiences that would not exist without us. We take pride in making titles that reach a large audience and creating communities that last. Our commitment to excellence has earned us recognition as one of the UK's Best Places to Work in games for eight consecutive years by gamesindustry.biz, and we're proud to be part of the Zynga and Take-Two Interactive family.

Position Overview:

NaturalMotion is looking for a talented and passionate Meta Designer to join our London studio, helping shape the combat experience for our first-person shooter mobile title. This role focuses on designing and managing metagame, live, and progression features to create a satisfying and sustainable mobile experience.

You will own key metagame features from conception through live, coordinating with design, art, UX, engineering, and product management throughout the whole process. As a live game you will need to design features with iteration and extensibility in mind and analyze live data to expand and improve your features over time. We are looking for someone who brings both craft knowledge, an excitement to try new things, and a genuine love of action games.

We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role you will work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.

What You'll Do:

  • Ownership of designing, prototyping, and implementing progression, economy, and engagement features that align with the creative vision of the game
  • Help define, analyze, and take action on analytics, feature data, and KPIs
  • Work closely with live and product management teams to define goals and implement solutions to boost engagement
  • Collaborate closely with art, animation, audio, design and engineering teams to build content and solve problems in a multi-disciplinary environment
  • Develop and balance in-game economies across many different metagame features
  • Work closely with UX and engineering to ensure features are implemented in ways that meet the engagement goals
  • Analyse player data, feedback, and behaviours to identify and fix metagame issues and retention barriers
  • Work concurrently on multiple features at varying stages of development, managing priorities effectively as content pipelines run in parallel
  • Document and communicate metagame feature concepts clearly to ensure alignment across all development teams

What You Bring:

  • Previous experience in Metagame / Progression / Engagement Design or an equivalent role in the video game industry
  • At least one shipped title in a design role for a live service title

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Data Engineer

London (Waterloo) · Full-time · Hybrid, three days per week in the office

Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.  We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.  We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property.  We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents.  We’re looking for someone to own that foundation.

The opportunity

You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have.  The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use.  You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform.  There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

Own data as a product.  Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable.

Be opinionated about sources and quality.  Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled.

jobs.description:
This is a high impact, visible role. As our Founder Associate, you'll support the CEO & COO and augment their capacity by taking on problems to solve that are critically important to how we build all aspects of GetGround. Some weeks that means building the model that decides whether we enter a new market. Others it means untangling why a core funnel is leaking, or writing the board paper, or problem solving what seems like the impossible task. You'll be in a role that will require you to use your expert communication skills, analytical mindset, commercial accumen and intellect to support in propelling us through our next stage of growth.

What you'll do

Own the CEO & COO’s highest-priority problems end to end , usually two or three at a time, each lasting anywhere from a fortnight to a quarter. You'll define the question, do the analysis, form a view, get buy-in, and see it through to execution.

Do the analysis yourself.  You'll pull the data, build the model, and stress-test your own conclusions before anyone else does. We don't have an army of analysts for you to delegate to, and we like it that way.

Turn strategy into things that ship.  You will be accountable for shipping these initiatives, creating impact and own the result.

Prepare the CEO & COO for the rooms that matter , board meetings, investor conversations, partnership negotiations. You'll shape what gets said.

Spot what nobody is looking at.  A good Founder Associate brings problems to the CEO & COO as often as they receive them.

What we are looking for

Agency and resilience

A unwavering work ethic and desire to scale a business

2 to 5 + years in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or an operating role at a high-growth startup.

Strong commercial judgement. You can look at a messy situation, work out which two numbers actually matter, and be roughly right quickly rather than precisely right too late.

You write and communicate difficult concepts and topics in simple, clear terms and to an expert level.

You can influence without authority

High tolerance for ambiguity and pace. Priorities shift. Projects get killed. If that sounds exhausting rather than energising, this isn't the role.

Nice to have

Exposure to fintech or regulated financial services

Experience taking something from zero to one inside an existing company

We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to be a core part of GetGround's legal function, providing sharp, commercially minded legal advice across the business as we scale.  You'll be doing the legal work, advising on commercial contracts, product questions, regulatory matters, and everything in between. You'll be a trusted partner to teams across the business and a key part of how we manage legal risk day-to-day.

GetGround operates at the intersection of fintech, proptech and wealthtech. jobs.description:
About Us  Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.

We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.
We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role  This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers.

Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, and related platform tooling.

Design service boundaries, API contracts, relational data models, and integration flows for complex property operations. Produce ERDs and other technical diagrams where they make relationships, ownership, and system behaviour easier to review.

Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows using technologies such as Celery and Redis.

Write complex SQL, evolve PostgreSQL schemas safely, and optimise database performance where customer experience or operational throughput depends on it.

jobs.description:
About Nous

Nous is an AI agent  that takes some of the load of life; making good decisions and acting for our users in areas where they’re not the experts or aren’t paying enough attention. We've started with optimising bills, where we're already saving households thousands, and are now expanding into new categories. Similar to how Amazon picked books as its first category and grew from there.

We’re growing fast, and it's working.  20x YoY growth makes us one of the fastest scaling startups in the UK. And NPS of +70 (higher than Apple) shows that our users love it.  We've just launched two more novel new products (on top of our existing bill optimisation). Insurance: we're the first to get the regulatory approval and build the tech to actually do the full insurance discovery and purchase journey as an agent for the user (not just give them a link to the best deal). Subscription management: lots of companies use Open Banking to draw pretty graphs – we're the first to use it to actively save people money starting by cancelling unwanted subscriptions for them.  It would be easy to look at this and think we've got it all figured out. But we've only scratched the surface; our ambitions are SO much higher.

Still -  the problems we’re solving are hard .  ‘Talk is cheap’  applies to agents too. To have REAL impact, agents need to break out of the sandbox and take action in the real world where there are consequences. This means solving all the hard, thorny, interesting, frustrating problems the real world has to offer.

How we build (worth reading before the role)

Most companies split the thinkers, the doers and the builders. We don't. Something special happens when they're the same people: a small team that builds and owns the tools for its own problems understands those problems from the inside. So the rule at Nous is simple. The person who feels the problem should be the one who builds the fix.  This isn't brand new. A sharp generalist could always wire something together with no-code and low-code tools to solve a problem. The catch was the ceiling: those tools were far more limited than real code, so you hit a wall the moment the problem got interesting. The Staff Engineer, AI / ML — Self-Serve Toolchain will build the end-to-end system that lets customers adapt UFORCE models on their own private data without exposing that data to us.  This role spans  data processing, foundation-model-assisted labeling, human-in-the-loop QA, active learning, training, evaluation, and model promotion . You will turn an in-flight principal-led capability into a repeatable toolchain that non-expert customers can run safely on-site.

What you’ll do

Own the ML adaptation pipeline from raw customer data to trained, evaluated, deployable models.

Build foundation-model-assisted labeling workflows using tools such as  SAM-2 ,  Grounding DINO , open-vocabulary models, LLM steering, and human review.

Design self-serve operator workflows using yes/no/maybe feedback and natural-language corrections.

Create versioned datasets with lineage, data cards, label provenance, class distributions, and known gaps.

Build QA methods that catch systematic pseudo-label errors, missing annotations, and long-tail data gaps.

Develop active-learning loops that prioritize the highest-value frames for limited operator review.

Build reproducible train/eval pipelines with experiment tracking, model packaging, and promotion gates.

Design evaluation around held-out anchor sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and automated approve/reject decisions.

Package the toolchain for on-prem, air-gapped, regulated, or customer-held environments.

Close the field-failure loop by feeding live failures back into the next tune cycle.

Lead and grow a small specialist team around curation, auto-labeling, deployment, and onboarding.

What success looks like

Customers can run a full adaptation cycle without engineer intervention.

Customer data stays inside the customer boundary.

The system produces trusted datasets with clear provenance and quality signals.

Pseudo-label quality is measured and systematic errors are caught early.

The promotion gate can approve or reject models based on evidence, not intuition.

Evaluation is protected by anchor sets, leakage controls, slice metrics, and baseline comparisons.

Field failures become reproducible inputs to the next training cycle.

Synthetic data is used only when it proves value against real held-out data.

The toolchain becomes a repeatable capability supported by a small, ramped team.

Für unseren Mandanten, ein etabliertes mittelständisches Unternehmen im Raum Merzig, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Inhouse Consultant ERP / Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (m/w/d) in Vollzeit. Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Festanstellung direkt beim Unternehmen.

Aufgaben

Sie betreuen und entwickeln gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen die ERP- und Prozesslandschaft des Unternehmens weiter. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

Betreuung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Geschäftsprozesse

Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung interner Unternehmensabläufe

Unterstützung der Anwender bei Fragen rund um Business Central

Durchführung von Tests und Qualitätssicherung bei neuen oder angepassten Softwarelösungen

Dokumentation von Systemänderungen, Prozessen und Anwendungen

Unterstützung im Microsoft-365-Umfeld, insbesondere Teams, SharePoint und Exchange Online

Mitarbeit an Digitalisierungs-, Automatisierungs- und KI-Projekten

Einführung neuer IT-gestützter Arbeitsweisen

Abstimmung mit internen Ansprechpartnern und externen IT- bzw. Softwarepartnern

Punktuelle Unterstützung bei technischen IT-Themen

Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf ERP, Unternehmensprozessen und Digitalisierung.

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen oder informationstechnischen Bereich, beispielsweise in:

Informatik

Wirtschaftsinformatik

Fachinformatik

IT-Systemmanagement

Auch ein anderer beruflicher Hintergrund ist möglich, wenn Sie praktische Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen, Unternehmensprozessen oder Digitalisierungsthemen mitbringen. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie idealerweise mit:

Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central oder einem vergleichbaren ERP-System wie SAP, Sage oder ähnlichen Lösungen

Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365

Interesse an Prozessoptimierung und Digitalisierung

Interesse an KI, Automatisierung, LLMs oder modernen Softwarelösungen

Kenntnisse in Power Platform oder Microsoft Azure sind von Vorteil

Analytisches Denken und technisches Interesse

Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Sie müssen noch kein ausgewiesener Business-Central-Spezialist sein. Auch Bewerber mit Erfahrung in anderen ERP-Systemen sowie engagierte Berufseinsteiger mit gutem Verständnis für IT und Geschäftsprozesse sind willkommen. Entscheidend sind Ihre Motivation, Ihr Prozessverständnis und Ihre Bereitschaft, sich intensiv in die bestehende Systemlandschaft einzuarbeiten.

Benefits

Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit langfristiger Perspekt

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.  Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.  You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabri

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Operations Engineer  1. About the role  Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.  For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.  We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.  The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.  You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.  2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at.  Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve.  This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people di

Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.  Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software  und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).  Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter,  und

digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.  Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir  3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs  (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.  Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
jobs.description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to  unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done .  Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars.  Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run.

Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the  cost per insight  changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions.  That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a  digital twin of fermentation at any scale .  We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us.  Now we are hiring the  first role dedicated entirely to lab automation . You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here.  This is, in many ways,  the role we always wished existed : high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work.  This is not a role for someone who wants to select the next six-figure laboratory automation system from a catalogue. We want someone who looks at a €500,000 solution and asks:  Why does this cost €500,000? What problem are we actually solving? And could we achieve the same outcome - or a better one - for a fraction of the cost and at 10x the scale?

Sometimes the answer will be an established lab instrument. Sometimes it will be an industrial robot, a €50 sensor, a 3D-printed part, and some clever engineering.  Your opportunity is to help us  completely rethink how lab automation is done  and build the infrastructure that makes biological R&D dramatically faster and cheaper.

Key responsibilities:

Own lab automation at Differential Bio  end-to-end, from creating individual components to developing complete new automated fermentation systems, including technical decisions, experimentation, suppliers, and budget.

Drive our ambition to dramatically increase experimental density while reducing the cost per experiment and cost per insight.

Translate wet-lab workflows into reliable, scalable automation together with our scientists, software engineers, and ML engineers.

Make pragmatic  build vs. buy vs. modify  decisions instead of defaulting to expensive, closed laboratory automation platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents

Sage AI Labs · Munich · Full-time · [Remote]

About us

Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of.  The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

About the role

We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them.  You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO.

What you'll own

Our checkout agents.  Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic.

Ingestion at scale.  Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself.

Search and ranking.  Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing.

What we're looking for

5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python

You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident

You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you

You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. These systems spend customers' money, so a silent failure is a wrong order, not a red build

You can move without a finished spec. We are small, and the roadmap changes when the market does

Nice to have

Built AI-first products or LLM-based agents in production, not just in a prototype

Working knowledge of classic ML and deep learning, enough to reason about retrieval and ranking rather than only calling an API

Background in e-commerce, payments, or fraud and risk infrastructure

Why this role

Very few engineers get to own a category-defining system while the category is still being defined. This is one of those seats, at the point where it still counts as early. A year from now this problem will have a standard answer and someone will have written it. We intend for that to be us.  Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

jobs.description:
Your way into the future

As a Working Student in Purchasing, you'll help keep our SAP master data clean, accurate, and reliable — supporting the planning and procurement decisions that depend on it every day.

What awaits you at Mynaric

Clean and maintain SAP master data (material master, source lists, info records, purchasing views).  Identify and resolve incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data entries in coordination with Buyers and Planning.  Support standardization of master data fields and naming conventions across categories.  Help build and maintain data governance routines to keep master data consistent over time.  Build simple reports/dashboards (Excel, SAP queries) to track data quality and flag recurring errors.  Reduce manual effort by identifying repetitive data-cleanup tasks and proposing lightweight fixes or automation.  Support the rollout of new data standards as they're defined by the Purchasing team.  Collaborate with Buyers, Planners, and IT/ERP to trace data issues back to their source.

What you bring with you

Currently enrolled in a degree program in industrial engineering, supply chain, business administration, information systems, or similar. Strong attention to detail and comfort working through large, messy datasets.  Solid Excel skills; basic familiarity with Power Automate, Power BI, or similar tools is a plus.  Structured, methodical way of working.  Curiosity about manufacturing/procurement processes and how clean data drives planning accuracy.  Fluency in English; German skills are a plus.

Be part of the company that is changing the world!

jobs.description:

App Store Optimisation . Du testest Screenshots, Icon, Titel und Beschreibungen laufend weiter.

Akquisition und früher Funnel.  Dein Fokus liegt auf der Gewinnung neuer Nutzer. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Team bewertet Ihr, welche Zielgruppen und Kanäle den besten LTV bringen, und verbessert danach die Signup- und Activation-Flows im frühen Funnel.

Copy und Botschaften.  Du formulierst, was StudySmarter Lernenden bringt, so dass es bei unserer Zielgruppe ankommt und konvertiert. Headlines auf Landing Pages, Ad-Copy, Video-Skripte, Plakatmotive und mehr.

Content und Kampagnen mit AI.  AI-Content-Projekte, Markenaufbau für unsere Jobboards, Out-of-Home-Kampagnen.

Love Brand aufbauen.  Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns eine globale Love Brand für B2C und B2B und prägst mit, wie StudySmarter aussieht und klingt.

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Keine klassische Designstelle. Geschmack und Markenurteil sind wichtig, die handwerkliche Ausführung läuft über AI und Freelancer.  Kein Performance-Marketing-Job. Kanäle, Budget, Bidding und Attribution liegen an anderer Stelle im Team.  Keine Briefing-Rolle. Du machst die Arbeit selbst, statt sie weiterzugeben.  Keine Product-Rolle. Du bist kein Product Manager. Du trägst die Nutzerakquisition und arbeitest dafür eng mit dem Product Team zusammen, ohne Pro

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Über ]init[  Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

Deine Mission bei ]init[  Als Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders) verantwortest du in interdisziplinären Projektteams die visuelle Gestaltung anspruchsvoller Fachanwendungen, Portale und Informationsangebote – im Public- und Health-Sector ebenso wie in regulierten Branchen der Privatwirtschaft, etwa im Energiesektor.

Du gibst komplexen digitalen Produkten eine klare, eigenständige und hochwertige visuelle Sprache. Von der übergeordneten visuellen Leitidee über Layout, Typografie und visuelle Hierarchie bis hin zur Ausarbeitung von Komponenten, Interaktionen und Zuständen. Dabei entstehen responsive, barrierearme und technisch umsetzbare Oberflächen, die auch bei hoher fachlicher Komplexität Orientierung schaffen.

Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Kundenanforderungen, Erkenntnissen aus der Nutzerforschung, Konzeption und visueller Umsetzung: Du denkst Design strategisch, treibst Design-Prozesse voran und verbindest konzeptionelle Stärke mit einem hohen Maß an visueller Präzision – auch an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gestaltung und technischer Umsetzung.

Designsysteme sind für dich dabei kein Nebenprodukt, sondern das Rückgrat deiner Arbeit: Du baust sie auf, hältst sie über Produkte hinweg konsistent und sorgst dafür, dass sie in der Entwicklung tatsächlich ankommen. Und du nutzt KI dort, wo sie deine Arbeit besser macht: schneller zu Varianten und Umsetzung, breiter in Recherche und Analyse, konsequenter in der Qualitätssicherung – ohne die Entscheidung aus der Hand zu geben.

Das gibt es zu tun

Du verantwortest den Designprozess in Kundenprojekten, von der Vision und Definition der Design-Sprache bis zum finalen UI. Du gestaltest visuell und fachlich anspruchsvolle Benutzerflows und Oberflächen für komplexe Anwendungen konsistent, zugänglich und umsetzbar  Du berätst strategisch unsere Kund:innen und Projektteams bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Produkte: Du bringst Nutzersicht und Marktbeobachtung zusammen, zeigst Optionen auf und begründest Designentscheidungen so, dass sie im Haus des Kunden tragen  Du verantwortest Designsysteme über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus und sorgst dafür, dass das Designsystem im Team gelebt wird: Dokumentation, Contribution-Regeln, Reviews und Schulung von Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen  Du berätst Kund:innen auf Augenhöhe, moderierst Workshops und machst Designentscheidungen nachvollziehbar – auch gegenüber nicht-gestalterischen Stakeholdern. Wo Produkt und Kommunikation zusammenwirken, denkst du beides zusammen  Du übernimmst die kreative Federführung bei Angeboten und Ausschreibungen und präsentierst in Pitches  Du setzt KI-Tools geziel

jobs.title: Senior ML Research Engineer, Virtual Cell
jobs.description:
About SandboxAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.  We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.  At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity  The AI Sim R&D team builds leading-edge ML and physics-based models ("LQMs") to advance drug discovery. Within this team,  AQCell  is our virtual cell platform: it takes a cell representation (e.g. basal gene expression) and a perturbation descriptor (e.g. SMILES, dose, and time), predicts the resulting transcriptomic response, and maps that response through pathway activity to functional endpoints such as cell viability, IC50, and toxicity dose-response — helping drug discovery scientists understand the biological repercussions of a compound across the cell, not just whether it binds its target.  As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline. You will work across large, heterogeneous transcriptomic and functional-endpoint datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, and DILImap), train and evaluate expression-perturbation and cell-viability prediction models over them, and help harden our evaluation pipeline and baselines so we can trust and improve model performance over time. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning and biology, and offers the opportunity to shape how virtual cell models are trained, validated, and scaled toward real drug discovery decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Model Development:  Build, train, and maintain machine learning models for expression-perturbation prediction (e.g. transcriptomic response to a drug perturbation) and downstream functional-endpoint prediction (e.g. cell viability, IC50, toxicity dose-response).

Large-Scale Dataset Management:  Acquire, harmonize, and manage large-scale biological datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, DILImap) — including schema harmonization, normalization, and de-duplication across cell, drug, and assay identifiers — and manage model training pipelines over these pooled datasets.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Account Abuse team is tasked with ensuring Anthropic's computing capacity is allocated fairly, minimizing resources available to bad actors and preventing them from coming back. As a software engineer on this team, you will build the machine learning systems that help us detect and stop abuse at scale. The ideal candidate can see things from opponents' perspectives, understand their means and motives, and anticipate their responses to countermeasures.

We're looking for full stack machine learning engineers with experience across model training, productionization, and evaluation. You'll also look for ways to use Claude to speed up how these models get built and maintained.

This is classical ML on structured and behavioral data. You do not need a deep learning background or knowledge of LLM internals. What matters is that you have trained and shipped models where the stakes are real, and that you care about building robust production systems as much as the model itself. A false positive here is a legitimate customer locked out, so measurement, precision, and safe rollout are part of the job.

Key responsibilities

  • Make backtesting, shadow deployment, and staged rollout the default path to production, with monitoring for training / serving skew, drift, and adversarial adaptation
  • Work with our data scientists and our Policy & Enforcement team to improve label coverage and quality
  • Partner with product and platform teams to gather signals and integrate model decisions with minimal impact on their systems' latency, stability, or overall architecture

Minimum qualifications

Our Mission  At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.  We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE  As a Reinforcement Learning Intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather.  This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware.

**Verdancy is a start up in the making from the Schwaneberg Group at the Institute of Biotechnology of RWTH Aachen University. It develops biodegradable additives that make crop-protection products stick to leaves and last longer. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Mercura ( YC W25 ) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the  $12 trillion industry  behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and  eightfolded our revenue in 12 months . With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked.  That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything.  We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you.

What you will be working on

Find the real problem.  Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building.

Ship it yourself.  Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it.

Know if it worked.  Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so.

Set the quality floor.  Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you.

Compress the loop.  Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR.

What we're looking for

Evidence of discovery.  You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong.

Evidence of analytics.  You've made a product decision from data you instrumented yourself. You know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered.

Taste.  You notice when spacing is off, when a flow doesn't communicate, when an interaction feels sluggish — and you fix it without being asked. We'll look at what you've made.

Real code shipped to real users.  React and TypeScript to production. Not prototypes, not a bootcamp project. Some Python helps; we can teach it.

AI as leverage, not as identity.  We don't care which tools you use. We care that you've restructured how you work around them and can show us the difference it made.

German and English.  Our users are almost entirely German-speaking. You'll be in those conversations from week one.

How we work

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our  Core Distribution team . The center of this role

Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent,

core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.

Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment
(image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).

Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and
SDK/runtime issues on the target.

Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up
through a fully operational stack.

Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and
related target hardware.

Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Home Infrastructure (Recommendation Systems)
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

Engineering Manager, Home Infrastructure

The Home Infrastructure team builds the mission-critical backend and data systems that power Roblox’s Homepage and Experience Details Page, two of the highest-traffic surfaces on Roblox. These surfaces reach the vast majority of Roblox’s daily active users and are core drivers of discovery, engagement, retention, and platform growth.

We are a full-stack product infrastructure team responsible for content distribution across Roblox. Our systems support multiple modes of user interaction, including exploratory browsing, directed discovery, and personalized content recommendations across the many types of content that make up the Roblox ecosystem.

This team sits at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, machine learning-powered personalization, data infrastructure, and product experimentation. We partner closely with Machine Learning, Data Science, Product, Design, Frontend, Ads, Marketplace, Virtual Economy, and other teams across Roblox to build the platforms that help users find the most relevant and engaging content.

As Engineering Manager for Home Infrastructure, you will lead a team of Backend and Data Engineers responsible for the end-to-end infrastructure powering Roblox’s most important discovery surfaces. You will guide the team’s technical strategy, grow engineering talent, and drive execution on high-impact systems that operate at massive scale.

You Will

  • Lead and grow a high-performing team of Backend and Data Engineers responsible for the infrastructure powering Roblox’s Homepage and other Discovery product surfaces.
  • Define and execute the technical roadmap for large-scale content discovery, personalization, ranking, data, and backend-serving systems.
  • Drive high-impact initiatives such as Personalization-as-a-Platform, full-page personalization, real-time user signal infrastructure, and ranking observability.

The Account Security (AccSec) pod sits within the Accounts team (part of the broader Safety organization) and is at the heart of building a safe and civil platform for users of all ages. Account Security is especially challenging at Roblox because it is open to all ages.

As the EM of AccSec pod (7+ ICs) you will work closely with peers throughout Roblox and the creator community to reduce the impact of account takeover (i.e. compromise) for Roblox players, creators, and the broader community. This is a role that requires entrepreneurship. We are looking for the EM of the AccSec pod to, in collaboration with product partners, to formulate a strategy for how to reduce ATO, reduce the impact of any remaining ATO and build community trust in the security of their accounts.

Examples of past and current efforts include:

  • Cryptographically binding user secrets to hardware backed secrets.
  • Detecting client side tampering by Browser extensions.
  • Integration with Passkeys.
  • Post-login modeling for ATO detection.
  • Reducing incentives for bad actors by making assets more recoverable.

While this is a security team that focuses heavily on product and infrastructure changes to improve security, we also consult on privacy and security reviews where relevant to Account Security.

  • Experience in account security, identity, or fraud detection, or abuse detection. The person selected with this role needs to have a good sense of what good looks like with respect to detecting and mitigating account takeover.
  • A track record of leading teams as they land security or abuse fighting features from inception, to prioritization, to alignment, to implementation and finally launch.
  • Experience in people leadership. You have led (and grown) high-performing engineering teams.

You will:

  • Be entrepreneurial. The EM

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.

  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.  Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.  You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabri

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Language Programmer to join our Verse team, which owns the toolchain (compiler, VM, and runtime) that powers game development in Unreal Engine and UEFN. You'll work on the systems every UE and UEFN developer relies on to build and ship games with Verse.

In this role, you will

  • Extend, evolve, and maintain the Verse compiler toolchain, transactional memory runtime and VM, add new platform support, implement new language features and integrate with Unreal Engine's content, build, and cooking pipelines
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and iteration times across the Verse toolchain, runtime and UE/Verse boundary
  • Work closely with language consumers to ensure an exceptional user experience
  • Establish test workflows to validate improvements and prevent regressions
  • Design and maintain the scripting interface to Unreal Engine, working in close collaboration with the Verse Language team and the broader UE engineering organization

What we're looking for

  • Expert knowledge of C++17 or later
  • Experience in compiler or toolchain development (e.g., compiler internals, VM design, Clang/LLVM, or linker/platform ABI specifics)
  • Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power
  • Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
  • Solid grounding in software engineering principles, including API design
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions
  • Experience with Unreal Engine integration is a plus

About the role

As a Deployment Manager on the Beneficial Deployments team, you will guide customers from a signed contract into a live, governed, and adopted deployment so that customers achieve tangible impact rather than simply incremental improvement with Claude. You'll guide organizations from contract signature to production deployment across Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and our API products, fundamentally changing how they work and deliver on their missions.

You'll be the technical hands that switch Claude on. Before any organization can drive adoption, before any champion can ship their first workflow, someone has to connect Claude to the customer's identity provider, get the right people provisioned into the right workspaces, and walk their CISO through how it all comes together. That's your work. You turn "we've signed the contract" into "our employees can log in, with the right access, under the right policies, the way our security team expects."

This is a high-leverage role where you'll pioneer scalable activation methodologies that enable hundreds of nonprofit customers to unlock transformative use cases and realize measurable outcomes at unprecedented speed. You won't just follow playbooks. You'll design the frameworks and repeatable processes that can be deployed consistently across diverse customer environments, and you'll shape them into programs that reach customers we could never serve one at a time.

You'll operate at the intersection of technical deployment, enablement, and program design. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. We're a small team working on products that millions of people use daily—and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet.

Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real-time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity.

We care deeply about craft—the details that make something feel polished and trustworthy—but we ship fast and learn in the open. We'd rather get something in front of users and iterate than wait for perfection.

You're excited to question fundamental UI assumptions and invent patterns that feel native to AI, and you're already using tools like Claude Code to extend what you can build. jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Who We Are:

Roblox is reimagining the way people come together to connect, create, and express themselves. To support our massive scale, we are powered by thousands of microservices. The Application Networking team connects and secures these services, building ingress gateways, managing the service mesh, and enabling seamless communication across Roblox’s hybrid on-prem and cloud infrastructure.

We are executing on Cloud Bursting, a strategic initiative to enable Roblox’s core services to transparently burst from on-prem data centers to the cloud, allowing us to handle historical peak concurrent players and survive regional failures. You will join our Service Mesh team to build the networking fabric that makes this possible.

You Will:

  • Design and build the service mesh infrastructure that enables communication across Roblox’s hybrid Kubernetes and Nomad environments, supporting billions of daily requests.
  • Drive the integration of service mesh with Kubernetes, ensuring reliable sidecar injection, mTLS, traffic policies, and observability for production workloads.
  • Build the networking foundation for Cloud Bursting, enabling Roblox’s top services to transparently burst from on-prem data centers to the cloud, with service discovery, traffic management, and locality-aware routing across environments.
  • Partner with internal application teams to understand their connectivity pain points, ensuring the service mesh provides a frictionless 'paved road' for thousands of developers
  • Collaborate with the Gateway and CNI teams to deliver a unified, multi-cluster service fabric that abstracts cluster and regional boundaries from application developers.
  • Serve as a primary escalation point for complex service mesh issues, troubleshooting across Envoy sidecars, Istio control plane, and the underlying network stack.
  • Act as a senior voice on the team

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Most of what makes Together AI so valuable for customers is invisible from the outside. Optimizing kernels, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and more create an industry-leading platform for inference and post-training at scale. As a technical marketing engineer, you are the conduit between the engineering and research work and the developers who should know about it. You go deep with product, engineering, research, and CX to learn the platform at the level of nuanced technical detail, then decide which details matter to an AI builder and build content that makes them care.

This is a creator role. You are a technical storyteller. You'll produce social-native posts, technical blogs, performance benchmarks, demo and explainer videos, and thought leadership, all aimed at one outcome: building Together’s credibility with developers. You'll also own our technical communities on X, YouTube, Discord, Linkedin and the engagement metrics for developer content company-wide, including amplifying the work of engineers and researchers who publish under their own names.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, DevRel, research, and CX to learn new capabilities in technical depth, then extract the most meaningful aspects for a developer audience.
  • Create the content strategy based on deep understanding of our company’s differentiation and marries that with an understanding of the content that would resonate.
  • Build technical content across formats: blogs, videos, benchmark reports, podcasts, and short-form posts that drive engagement with developers and preference for Together.
  • Monitor real-time news and announcements related to AI infrastructure and lead timely responses working with product and engineering
  • Own Together's presence in technical communities, primarily X, Discord and Youtube. Track engagement metrics, what lands, what doesn't, and adjust.
  • Drive amplification of engineering and research work across social channels.
  • Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community - understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
  • Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community
  • While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ DevRel teams

Requirements

  • 3+ years of product, technical or developer marketing
  • Experience creating content for infrastructure or technical systems, not user-facing SaaS applications. You've explained how something works under the hood.
  • Loves building social community presence, posting, engaging, monitoring with technical audiences, with experience managing channels

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

You'll own US and Canada payroll operations end-to-end — hands-on in Workday, close to the details — while also managing and developing 1–2 direct reports on the US team. You'll report directly to the Head of Global Payroll and be a key leader in making sure North American payroll keeps pace with Anthropic's growth.

Strategic importance: You'll be a key contributor to our compliance initiative — our framework for managing payroll tax obligations across US & Canada. You'll also be part of the team driving AI adoption within payroll: we're actively building out how AI tools can improve reconciliation accuracy, error detection, and reporting workflows. This isn't a future initiative — it's happening now.

jobs.title: Producer - MONOPOLY GO!
jobs.location: US - Culver City, California, United States
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Producer to join our Monopoly GO! team in our Culver City studio hub on a hybrid basis, or remotely within the US or Canada.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

What You Will Do
You will be embedded in one of our feature pods, working to deliver well tested, polished and innovative features for our players. We work on exciting projects and you will have the chance to create a significant impact on our players' experiences by ensuring your team has everything they need to be successful! You will:

  • Support live game incidents, including on call hours
  • Be responsible for the End to End feature team’s development pipeline and process
  • Ensure feature development and delivery is timely and of the highest quality
    Coordinate, prioritize, moderate and control all production activities in the assigned feature team
  • Support the pod in implementing and following Agile/Scrum way of working and thinking
  • Liaise between cross departments as per project and team’s needs
  • Set up effective, concise, clear and efficient communication protocols both inside and outside team
  • Lead process improvement initiatives that will aid in improving feature development or overall production pipeline

What We're Looking For

  • Experience within mobile game production
  • Ability to adapt and complete tasks on the fly
  • Skilled in facilitating cross-team discussion, organization and planning
  • Outstanding communication skills; adept at articulating sophisticated business situations to a variety of audiences
  • Strong ability to keep teams motivated and engaged
  • Exemplified understanding of Agile with its standard practices and understanding of the full SDLC
  • Steadfast self-motivation and initiative
  • A strong passion for making top quality games that players love

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: Product Management Director, FamXP
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

TRUST AND SAFETY

What We Do

The Epic Trust and Safety team provides a safer experience for Epic users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

FamXP, the Family Experience team within Trust, Safety, and Support, is responsible for the safety, privacy, and age-appropriate experience of kids and families across Epic's products. We ship features for kids and parents, review product updates across the company for safety and privacy considerations, collaborate with legal to translate regulatory requirements to an actionable product roadmap, and provide insights to our partner teams grounded in primary research we conduct with parents and players. This Product Management Director role will own complex, cross-product initiatives on the FamXP roadmap, set priorities for the FamXP team, and set the standard for how the FamXP product team operates.

In this role, you will

  • Drive FamXP initiatives from strategy through design, build, and launch, in partnership with engineering, QA, design, legal, policy, and analytics counterparts across multiple Epic product surfaces
  • Keep priorities clear, dependencies visible, and teams moving on what matters most
  • Develop and communicate FamXP strategy to the executive audience
  • Define metrics that matter, strengthen instrumentation where the signal is weak, and guide the team to ground decisions in data
  • Navigate a fast-evolving global regulatory landscape, partnering closely with legal and policy to translate new obligations into product deliverables (often on tight timelines)

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-product, or platform initiatives
  • Direct, hands-on experience partnering with legal, regulatory, or compliance teams, ideally in a regulated industry
  • Structured thinker who can bring clarity and momentum to an ambiguous problem space
  • Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable representing strategy and trade-offs to executive stakeholders
  • Quantitative thinker who drives visibility into product perf

jobs.description:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the runtime systems of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.
